title: 🔥 NEVER Say "Can We Be Friends?" (Do THIS Instead!) #Shorts

subtitles.en:
Alex, at a party or a coffee shop, how do you
start a conversation?
subtitles.zh: Alex，在派對或是咖啡廳裡，你都怎麼跟人開口聊天啊？

subtitles.en:
Definitely NOT: "Can we be friends?" or "What
is your hobby?"
subtitles.zh: 絕對「不要」說：「我們可以做朋友嗎？」或是「你的興趣是什麼？」

subtitles.en:
Wait! I literally learned "Do you want to be
friends?" in school! Is that weird?
subtitles.zh: 等等！我學校真的就是教「你想跟我做朋友嗎？」欸！這樣很怪嗎？

subtitles.en:
To native speakers, it sounds like a five-
year-old on a playground! It puts way too
much pressure on them.
subtitles.zh:
對英文母語人士來說，這聽起來超像五歲小孩在操場交朋友！
給人的壓力太大了。

subtitles.en:
Oh no, did they think I was a creep?! What
should I say instead?
subtitles.zh: 糟糕，那他們會不會覺得我是怪人啊？！那我應該改說什麼？

subtitles.en:
Rule number one: Comment on your
surroundings, not on them! For example:
"Crazy line today, right?" or "That drink
looks amazing, what is it?"
subtitles.zh:
第一大原則：觀察周遭環境，而不是評論對方！
例如：「今天排隊排得好誇張，對吧？」或是「那杯飲料看起來好讚，
是什麼啊？」

subtitles.en:
"That looks amazing, what is it?" Zero
pressure, love it! What about parties?
subtitles.zh: 「那看起來好讚，是什麼啊？」完全沒壓力，這句太棒了！那派對上呢？

subtitles.en:
Ask: "What brings you here?" It sounds smooth
and invites a story—never ask "Why are you
here?", which sounds like police questioning!
subtitles.zh:
你可以問：「今天是什麼風把你吹來的啊？」這樣聽起來很自然又能引導對方分
享故事——千萬別問「你為什麼在這裡？」，那聽起來超像警察在審問！

subtitles.en:
Got it! And what's your insider tip to keep
it going?
subtitles.zh: 懂了！那你有沒有什麼獨家秘訣可以讓話題繼續聊下去？

subtitles.en:
Don't ask "What do you do for work?" right
away. People hate talking about their boring
job on weekends! Instead, ask: "Working on
anything fun lately?"
subtitles.zh:
不要一上來就問「你在做什麼工作？」。大家週末最討厭聊無聊的工作了！
你可以改問：「最近有沒有在忙什麼有趣的事啊？」

subtitles.en:
"Working on anything fun lately?" That is
pure gold!
subtitles.zh: 「最近有沒有在忙什麼有趣的事啊？」這句簡直是黃金金句！

subtitles.en:
Comment on the room, keep it light, and
subscribe for more real-world English!
subtitles.zh: 從身邊周遭找話題、保持輕鬆隨意聊，記得訂閱學習更多道地英文喔！
